details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:582-595, 608-612, 1435-1450 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: After retargeting an open PR, the gate uses pre-PATCH mergeability and diff metadata for deterministic skip decisions, which can bypass review and conflict resolution for a PR that conflicts with its new base.
  WHY: A small or documentation-only PR can be skipped using stale `pr_mergeable` and diff values, bypassing the conflict resolver and potentially entering auto-merge despite conflicts on the new base.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:605-612, 841-985 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Retargeting changes the PR base but leaves its head SHA unchanged, so a terminal same-head marker from a prior run can still suppress review of the new base.
  WHY: The terminal marker still matches the unchanged head SHA, and the caller workflows do not ensure a follow-up review run after the base PATCH.
- scripts/retarget_merged_base.sh:62-65 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: When a merged branch has been deleted, the helper returns success without emitting the merged PR's base, so resolve mode returns the deleted branch name.
  WHY: The subsequent checkout of that branch fails; one reviewer rated this NIT while the others rated it MAJOR, so the highest severity is used.
- implement.yml:440-441; review_autofix.yml:456-457 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Neither workflow passes `RETARGET_MERGED_BASE_MAX_HOPS` into the helper's environment, so repository configuration of the hop limit is ignored.
  WHY: The helper uses its internal default of 3 hops in both integrated paths.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:430-449 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The optional retarget helper identity verification can hard-fail the gate job when its SHA, repository, or ref checks fail.
  WHY: A failed verification can prevent gate outputs from reaching `codex-agent`; one reviewer rated this MAJOR while the other rated it NIT, so the highest severity is used.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:488 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The reported `tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py` test failures cause the `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` job and aggregate `lint` check to fail.
  WHY: The test process exits non-zero with 7 reported failures.
- README.md:268-274 and lines 1724-1730 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `RETARGET_MERGED_BASE_MAX_HOPS` is omitted from both README repository-variable tables.
  WHY: Operators reading the README cannot discover the knob or verify its default and expected value format.
- tests/test_retarget_merged_base.py:1-152 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Several documented helper error paths and the new YAML verification failure branches lack tests.
  WHY: Regressions in the deleted-branch path, disabled and lookup-failed PR modes, hop-limit exhaustion, and helper identity checks can pass CI without coverage.
- scripts/retarget_merged_base.sh:line 53, `per_page=20` in closed-PR search | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The closed-PR search fetches only 20 results and selects the latest merged PR without pagination.
  WHY: A long-lived, reused branch name with more than 20 closed PRs may cause the helper to select from only the first page.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "The review gate retargets an open PR whose base is such a branch with one `PATCH` (it reads the base from the PR fetch it already makes; no call when the base is the default branch)"
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, near line 610 (retarget block) and line 1437 (conflict-suppression check)
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: The PATCH at line 610 changes the base, but the stale `pr_mergeable`, `pr_additions`, and `pr_deletions` values are used for the conflict-suppression and deterministic-skip checks without being refreshed.
- requirement: "Every failure keeps the branch and warns."
  expected_change_site: scripts/retarget_merged_base.sh, lines 62-65 (deleted-branch path)
  confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: When the target branch is deleted, `retarget_lookup_merged` returns 0 with empty output; resolve mode returns the deleted branch name and emits no warning for this case.
- requirement: "Logs `RETARGET_MERGED_BASE mode= repo= pr= from= to= merged_pr= outcome= reason=`"
  expected_change_site: scripts/retarget_merged_base.sh, resolve mode, successful retarget path (lines 114-115)
  confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: Resolve mode emits no log when already targeting the default branch or when no merged PR is found; pr mode also emits no log when target equals base.
- requirement: README variable rows (PR DESCRIPTION: "Docs and registration. README variable rows ...") and the changelog/agents.md references to `RETARGET_MERGED_BASE_MAX_HOPS`.
  expected_change_site: README.md repo-variable table (both the long table near line 268 and the short table near line 1724).
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: `RETARGET_MERGED_BASE_MAX_HOPS` is named in the changelog and script header but is not listed in either README variable table.
- requirement: "`RETARGET_MERGED_BASE_ENABLED` (default `true`)` kill switch wiring (PR DESCRIPTION: "Kill switch")"
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/implement.yml and .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml env blocks that also pass MAX_HOPS.
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The kill switch is wired, but `RETARGET_MERGED_BASE_MAX_HOPS` is not exported in either workflow.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- File: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
  Line or code reference: 605-612 (retarget) and ~835-979 (terminal same-head skip)
  PROBLEM: After a PR is retargeted to a new base, the terminal same-head resume marker (`REVIEW_AUTOFIX_PARTIAL_V1` with `resume_should_continue=false`) still matches the unchanged HEAD SHA and sets `SHOULD_RUN=false`, so the workflow skips reviewing the PR against its new base.
  WHY: A stacked PR that previously exhausted its review budget on the old base will not be reviewed against its new base after retargeting.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
  Line or code reference: 582-595 versus 1437
  PROBLEM: The gate PATCHes an open PR's base but continues using pre-PATCH `pr_mergeable` and diff-size metadata for the deterministic skip conflict-suppression check.
  WHY: If the old base was mergeable but the new base conflicts, stale metadata can let a doc-only or small-diff PR take the deterministic-skip path and bypass the conflict resolver.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: scripts/retarget_merged_base.sh
  Line or code reference: 62-65
  PROBLEM: When the target branch has been deleted, `gh api repos/<repo>/git/ref/heads/<branch>` returns 404, and the function exits `return 0` without emitting the already-fetched `<merged_pr_number> <base_ref>`.
  WHY: In resolve mode, the deleted branch name is returned as the target, and the subsequent checkout in implement.yml fails because the branch no longer exists.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- File: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
  Line or code reference: 438-449
  PROBLEM: The "Verify retarget helper identity" step hard-fails the gate job when verification fails, but does not have `continue-on-error`.
  WHY: The gate can fail entirely when `resolve_support.outputs.review_support_sha` is unset or malformed, despite the comment promising the gate runs without the helper when checkout fails or the feature is disabled.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- File: .github/workflows/implement.yml
  Line or code reference: 440-441, 513
  PROBLEM: `implement.yml` does not export `RETARGET_MERGED_BASE_MAX_HOPS` to the helper's environment.
  WHY: Setting the repository variable has no effect on resolve mode; the helper falls back to its default of 3.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
  Line or code reference: 456-457, 610
  PROBLEM: `review_autofix.yml` does not export `RETARGET_MERGED_BASE_MAX_HOPS` to the helper's environment.
  WHY: Setting the repository variable has no effect on pr mode; the helper falls back to its default of 3.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: "The review gate retargets an open PR whose base is such a branch with one `PATCH` (it reads the base from the PR fetch it already makes; no call when the base is the default branch)" — PR description.
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, near line 610 (retarget block) and line 1437 (conflict-suppression check)
  Evidence of absence: After the PATCH at line 610 changes the base, the stale `pr_mergeable` variable from line 594 is used at line 1437 for the conflict-suppression check without re-fetching mergeability. The stale `pr_additions` and `pr_deletions` are also used for the deterministic-skip size check.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: "Every failure keeps the branch and warns." — PR description and changelog.
  Expected change site: scripts/retarget_merged_base.sh, lines 62-65 (deleted-branch path)
  Evidence of absence: When the target branch is deleted, `retarget_lookup_merged` returns 0 with empty output at lines 62-65. This is treated as "no merged PR found" rather than "the branch was deleted after its PR merged." No warning is emitted for this specific case.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- Requirement: "Logs `RETARGET_MERGED_BASE mode= repo= pr= from= to= merged_pr= outcome= reason=`" — agents.md log prefix register.
  Expected change site: scripts/retarget_merged_base.sh, resolve mode, successful retarget path (lines 114-115)
  Evidence of absence: Resolve mode emits the `outcome=retargeted` log on successful retarget, but emits no log when already targeting the default branch or when no merged PR is found; pr mode similarly emits no log when target equals base.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
